# Change fixture (scenario E)

An active local-first milestone with an approved task. A new cloud-sync idea
arrives after approval.

The fixture asserts:

- the idea is captured as `CHG-*` without changing approved scope;
- impact traces to the objective, requirement, milestone and task;
- reject/defer preserves the plan and retains rationale;
- an approved narrow alternative changes only approved targets;
- a changed source baseline blocks applying the old proposal.
